Feature Request: Global Option to Hide Other Players' VRChat Items

I would like to suggest adding a global visibility setting that allows users to hide all VRChat Items belonging to other players.

Why is this feature important?

Many VRChat users play on mobile devices (Android and iOS) or standalone VR headsets such as Meta Quest, which have more limited hardware resources compared to PCs.

When multiple players display VRChat Items, especially in crowded instances, these objects may consume additional system resources, increase RAM usage, cause FPS drops, lag, and even lead to crashes or unexpected game closures.

This particularly affects users with lower-end mobile devices and standalone VR headsets.

My suggestion:

Add a global setting called "Hide Other Players' VRChat Items" with an ON/OFF toggle.

When enabled:

- Hide all VRChat Items belonging to other players.

- Keep players and their avatars fully visible.

- Reduce the additional performance impact caused by rendering these items.

- Allow users to customize item visibility individually if desired.

- Make this a client-side setting that does not affect what other players can see.

Expected benefits:

- Better performance on Android and iOS devices.

- Reduced visual clutter in crowded instances.

- Potentially lower memory usage and rendering overhead.

- Fewer performance-related crashes on Meta Quest headsets.

- A better experience for users with limited hardware.

I believe this feature would improve accessibility and performance for mobile and standalone VR users while allowing everyone to customize their VRChat experience.

Thank you for considering this feature request!
title: Feature Request: Global Option to Hide Other Players' VRChat Items
